annotations.title: Vehicle recalls by make, model and year

description: Lists NHTSA safety recall campaigns for a US-market vehicle by make, model and model year, newest first: campaign number, report date, component, a short defect summary, the safety risk, the remedy, any "do not drive" or "park outside" advisory, and a link to the NHTSA recall page. If the model name does not match NHTSA's naming, it returns the closest NHTSA model names for that make and year. It covers campaigns issued for the model, not whether a specific vehicle has been repaired.

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (1-50, default 10).

make.description: Vehicle make, e.g. "Honda", "Chevrolet", "Ford". Short forms such as "Chevy" and "VW" are accepted.
